name: collet
description: Holds a session inside the task it was given: one open task with the files it may touch and the command that ends it, a guard that refuses writes outside that list, and checks that each ship with a violation and a near miss so none of them counts as coverage before it has been shown to work.

interface.shortDescription: Hold a session inside the task it was given
interface.longDescription: One open task at a time, with the files it may touch and the command that ends it. A guard refuses a write outside that list and prints the one command that widens it with a recorded reason. Closing runs the accept command and checks that nothing landed outside the list first. A project that already plans its work in a roadmap it does not own is left alone: the mount writes nothing there.
